QuestInfo.name: Dark Times
QuestInfo.0: Motonari's training helped you a little, but it's still not enough. Who knows what enemies you'll face in this new world?
QuestInfo.1: This is no time for dark thoughts. It's time to move on.
QuestInfo.2: You forced yourself to keep going, in spite of everything that's happened.

0.0: The daimyo was good enough to provide me a training ground, despite their feeble resources, but my powers still elude me. The realities of this new world are maddening. Will I ever find my strength?
0.1: I must collect my thoughts. And perhaps find a good daikon-infused hot pot.

1.0: My first mission must be to regain my power. Only then will I be of use to the alliance.
1.1: Only then will I be able to save the princess. I cannot imagine the fear and strain she must be experiencing, but I will revisit it upon Nobunaga tenfold.
1.2: Before any of that, I must locate the scoundrel Oda Nobunaga. The people of this strange land can not possibly be prepared for the evil he will bring.
1.3: The road ahead is long and winding, frought with peril, as it must be. I will free Momijigaoka of its troubles, then I will deal with the demon king.
